result.title: ReDT: Resolution-Decoupled Visual Geometry Transformer
result.summary: We introduce ReDT, a feed-forward visual geometry transformer designed to scale multi-view reconstruction to high-definition (HD) inputs. Existing visual geometry transformers are typically trained at fixed, standard definition (SD) resolutions and exhibit degraded reconstruction quality and poor computational scaling to high input resolutions. While recent efficient architectures reduce the complexity of inter-frame attention, expensive intra-frame and encoder attention remain largely unaddressed, making HD reconstruction impractical with existing architectures. ReDT addresses both limitations with a resolution-aware architecture designed to scale to high-resolution inputs. The key idea of ReDT is to first map each view to a fixed-size set of basis tokens, compute correspondences in this compact constant-size basis space, and then project the outputs back to the original resolution for dense prediction. By decoupling the internal representation from input resolution during attention, ReDT substantially reduces the computational cost of high-resolution 3D reconstruction and improves model performance at all resolutions. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets spanning SD to FHD (2K) show that ReDT outperforms state-of-the-art visual geometry transformers in both reconstruction quality and computational efficiency. For instance, on the ETH3D (2K) dataset, ReDT achieves a $16\times$ speedup, a $34\%$ reduction in peak GPU memory usage, and a $33\%$ reduction in chamfer distance over VGGT-$Ω$. \href{https://redt.github.io}{Project Website.}

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ReDT，一种前馈视觉几何 transformer：先将每个视角映射为固定数量的 basis token，在这一恒定规模的紧凑空间中计算对应关系，再投影回原分辨率做稠密预测，使内部表示与输入分辨率解耦，从而把多视图重建扩展到 2K 高清输入并提升效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「固定大小 basis token 工作区 + 分辨率解耦」思路可供核查：或可类比 LVR 中 latent 状态容量设定、以及分辨率/长度变化下的泛化与视觉细节坍缩问题，但属 3D 重建场景，迁移仅为可能。
